Thanks for the quick feedback. Per our internal alignment (Naomi & Vanessa looped), attached is the requested evidence pack and the buyer-approval checklist. Key points up front:

- Activation SLA: Option A (12-month pilot style) = 5 business days from signed PO + evidence pack. Option B (24 months) = 10 business days.
